description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for specifying search filter parameters when querying employee leave information in the OrangeHRM system. It includes filtering options such as date ranges, leave statuses, employee number, and inclusion criteria.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for filtering employee leave search results, including date filters, status filters, employee number, and inclusion options.

methods.name: getStatuses
methods.description: Returns the array of leave statuses to filter by.

methods.name: setStatuses
methods.description: Sets the leave statuses to filter by, validating against allowed statuses.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the starting date filter for leave search.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the ending date filter for leave search.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Retrieves the inclusion criteria for employees.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the inclusion criteria for employees (only current, past, or both).
